decision.explanation: Q01 is broadly similar to C01 (excess_hall_adhesive). C01 ranks first by a wide margin in gain-centered Welch shape (2.98 dB versus 7.48–10.48 dB for the others), and uniquely combines the matching 5.3 Hz component, identical 68.03-microsecond periodicity, repeated impulsive time pattern, and persistent approximately 16 kHz feature. The main conflict is a frequency shift of C01's roughly 170–193 Hz cluster to Q01's roughly 936–981 Hz cluster, which transfers relative power into the 500–1000 Hz band and changes harmonic spacing without erasing the broader pattern. All reports have equal 44.1 kHz sampling, 10 s coverage, and matched resolution, so this shift is physical in the reported axes rather than a sampling artifact; absolute FS levels remain secondary because acquisition gain is unknown.
